root_cause_identification.expected_solution: Agent must identify both sides of the asymmetric ring-health policy: the Loki gateway-client store (pkg/storage/stores/series/series_index_gateway_store.go::GetChunkRefs) and the dskit ring health policy (ring/ring.go::IsHealthy). The report must explain that LEAVING is treated differently between the Read op (client) and the Reporting op (server), and that this asymmetry — not gateway downtime — is the source of the user-facing failure.
evaluation_criteria: Names pkg/storage/stores/series/series_index_gateway_store.go (or series_index_gateway_store) on the Loki side
Names ring/ring.go::IsHealthy (or equivalent dskit health function) as the consumer of the op enum
Identifies LEAVING as the instance state that triggers the failure
States that the policy is asymmetric between Read and Reporting (or between gateway-client and gateway-server)
Frames the issue as a ring-health-policy / op-enum problem, not a network or process outage

error_chain_trace.expected_solution: Agent must trace at least four hops: rolling restart of the index-gateway StatefulSet -> one or more instances enter LEAVING -> GetReplicationSetForOperation(Read) returns the LEAVING instance -> IsHealthy mismatch between Read and Reporting (LEAVING is healthy for Reporting but unhealthy for Read) -> the caller surfaces 'no replicas found' / 'too many unhealthy instances'.
evaluation_criteria: Mentions the rolling restart of the index-gateway StatefulSet (or rolling deploy / rolling update) as the trigger
Mentions LEAVING as the ring state of the affected instance
Mentions GetReplicationSetForOperation (or the dskit replication-set lookup) as the candidate-set step
Mentions IsHealthy returning different verdicts for Read vs Reporting (asymmetric op-dependent health)
Surfaces the user-visible error as 'too many unhealthy instances' or 'no replicas found' or 'at least 1 healthy replica required'

affected_components.expected_solution: Agent must name the Loki query frontend, the Loki index gateway (client and/or server), and the dskit ring as the affected components.
evaluation_criteria: Names the Loki query frontend (the caller of GetChunkRefs)
Names the Loki index gateway (client store and/or the gateway-server pods)
Names the dskit ring (ring package, IsHealthy, or replication_strategy)

remediation_proposal.expected_solution: Agent must propose at least one concrete remediation: (a) fix dskit's IsHealthy / ring health policy so LEAVING is healthy under Read, OR (b) align Loki's chosen health-op enum on the gateway-client with the gateway-server side so both views agree on LEAVING.
evaluation_criteria: Proposes either a dskit-side fix (IsHealthy / op policy / LEAVING semantics) or a Loki-side fix (op enum alignment between gateway-client and gateway-server)
Identifies where the fix would live (dskit ring/ring.go, Loki series_index_gateway_store, or Loki gateway client)
